method_preservation.entry: Once per own batch: frozen native entry rows/teacher/anchors/K, symmetric V13 C0/H metric and existing retained QR-SVD. FP32 native count division then FP64 metric; no jitter, rank changes or diagonal-only cost. All logical B cross terms retained. Actual cumulative Delta is committed W_entry.double()-W_initial.double(), not sum of ideal updates.
method_preservation.fit: D=a*u. Native subject action is Y=D*S on exact global row/owner, with full cross-owner Jacobian. Direct-D fastpath only after whole operator S=E proof, not current-point equality. Frozen full BxB quadratic and alignment caches, no candidate actual writer/solve backward. SUM loss gradients; reporting mean. Each candidate uses all rows before synchronous updates, no permanent request freeze. Add analytic norm and allocation gradient once each. Common stop iff all native Jr<.05, not allocation-inflated or independently frozen. Terminal candidate has no backward/update.
method_preservation.cost: CD_Q: sum Q; CD_C: sum [Q+2*lambda_C*abs(c_l)] with per-layer abs and sign(0)=0. Method F means cost matrix while implementation F means Bmap and implementation C means cost matrix; use explicit naming.
method_preservation.lambda: Once at first nonzero projected-action B1 candidate, usually c1, FP64 norm(g_norm_u)/norm(g_Q_u) over all layers/owners with ratio1. Preserve .5 native norm. Shared exact immutable source/pack/W0/geometry/candidate/gradient/lambda receipt for both arms and all20batches. CD_C consumes lock and verifies own cold B1 equality; no second calibration fit, coefficient sweep/epsilon/clip/default. Allzero stays pending with unchangedDelta check. Dependency/atomic join must not deadlock a single-slot schedule.
method_preservation.commit: Original CD direct target D per owner; all native rewrite+KL subject constraint rows, explicit counts/weights/lookup. Recompute upper actual K after lower all-token writes. Qualified first-site/same-A factor reuse only within valid transaction. FP64 ideal U -> native FP32 cast/add. Append final rewrite-only native mean-key CPUFP32 H exactly once/layer after all writes. Each arm own W/H/RNG chain, no shared candidates/weights/history.
method_preservation.gap: Actual fit injection Y is the telemetry reference: virtual_pre=virtual_post-Y, inherited=actual_pre-virtual_pre, direct_fit_error=actual_local-Y. Requested error actual_local-D_owner is separate. Record predicted vs actual costs, rank/range, energy and real FP32 action.
